_comment: Native connector coverage registry. Must equal core/conan/coverage.cpp (tests/drift_test.py). 'status' is evidence (live-supported needs MCP plus client evidence); 'implementation' says whether native code exists ('native') or the action still answers a structured not-ported error ('pending').

statusLegend.live-supported: Native code exists and was proven live through Takaro with MCP and client evidence.
statusLegend.schema-fallback: Answers the schema-valid empty DTO Takaro requires because the data does not exist for this game.
statusLegend.unsupported: Answers a structured error because neither the game nor Takaro can back it.
statusLegend.pending: Native code is missing or not yet proven live; transitional, must be gone before release.

getPlayer.responseShape: public Takaro player DTO or null
getPlayer.verification: MCP getPlayer through gameserverGetPlayers / playerongameserverSearch (not yet run live)
getPlayer.reason: Same snapshot as getPlayers; an offline player answers the last record seen in this process, else a minimal record from the requested id (Takaro rejects every no-player answer).

getPlayers.verification: MCP gameserverGetPlayers with the client online (not yet run live)
getPlayers.reason: Worker-thread safe self-reads (process_vm_readv): GameStateBase.PlayerArray -> PlayerState -> Owner controller; Steam64 from UserIDFromURLOptions, name PlayerNamePrivate, ip SavedNetworkAddress, ping ExactPing (PlayerState+824, checked once against GetPingInMilliseconds). No RCON.

getPlayerLocation.responseShape: { x: number, y: number, z: number }
getPlayerLocation.verification: MCP location vs client coordinates (not yet run live)
getPlayerLocation.reason: Worker read: Controller.Pawn -> RootComponent -> RelativeLocation, or ComponentToWorld (+0x210, checked against K2_GetActorLocation) when attached to a mount; the last known position while dead/offline.

getPlayerInventory.verification: MCP inventory vs the client inventory screen (not yet run live)
getPlayerInventory.reason: Worker read of the backpack, hotbar and equipment ItemInventory lists (torn-read checked, game-thread copy as fallback); stack and durability from the GameItem stat arrays (checked against GetIntStat/GetFloatStat); fist templates 51204/51205 dropped; amounts summed per code and durability %.

giveItem.verification: MCP plus the item in the client
giveItem.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: CheatSpawnItem or the in-process console executor.

listItems.responseShape: Takaro item DTO array with display names
listItems.verification: MCP itemSearch sample has display names and zero class names (not yet run live)
listItems.reason: /Game/Items/ItemTable rows with their localised names (worker FText decode checked against Conv_TextToString), codes from ItemNameToTemplateID; XX_/dev/test rows dropped, duplicate names get ' (#templateId)'. Built once per process.

listEntities.responseShape: Takaro entity DTO array with display names
listEntities.verification: MCP entitySearch sample has display names and zero class names (not yet run live)
listEntities.reason: /Game/Systems/SpawnTable/SpawnDataTable rows: code = row name (also ConanCharacter.SourceSpawnTable on live NPCs), localised name, NPC class only in metadata. Built once per process.

listLocations.verification: MCP listLocations sample (not yet run live)
listLocations.reason: /Game/Systems/Map/MapMarkers_ConanSandbox named places of the loaded map with world coordinates and discovery radius; retried until the table is loaded.

executeConsoleCommand.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: the engine's own console executor in-process (never RCON).

sendMessage.verification: Live 2026-10-03 on rig 349 (bridge stopped): MCP gameserverSendMessage global and directed (opts.recipient.gameId + senderNameOverride) -> native log delivered=1 each, both lines in the client chat (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L1)
sendMessage.reason: ClientReceiveChatMessage on each online ConanPlayerController through ProcessEvent on the game thread; global, or directed by Steam64 / character name.

teleportPlayer.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback.

testReachability.verification: Live 2026-10-03: MCP gameserverTestReachabilityForId -> {connectable:true, reason:null} from the native library with the bridge stopped; unknown-build path covered by tests/so_test.py
testReachability.reason: In-process: connectable when the server build is pinned and the ProcessEvent hook is installed; an unknown build answers connectable=false with the reason.

kickPlayer.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback.

banPlayer.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback.

unbanPlayer.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback.

listBans.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback.

shutdown.verification: countdown in the client plus process exit
shutdown.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); answers a structured error naming the action. No RCON fallback. Planned: Conan's own admin shutdown with its countdown.

getMapInfo.responseShape: { enabled: false, mapBlockSize: 0, maxZoom: 0, mapSizeX: 0, mapSizeY: 0, mapSizeZ: 0 }
getMapInfo.reason: Hosted Takaro shows no map tiles for Generic servers; answers the disabled MapInfo DTO Takaro validates.

getMapTile.verification: MCP gameserverGetMapTile returns the structured error
getMapTile.reason: Hosted Takaro shows no map tiles for Generic servers; no tile renderer exists for Conan.

player-connected.reason: K2_PostLogin (BaseGameMode_C override) through the ProcessEvent hook dispatch: Steam64 from ConanPlayerController.UserIDFromURLOptions, name and IP from the PlayerState, cached per controller. Live proof pending.

player-disconnected.reason: K2_OnLogout through the hook dispatch, identity from the PostLogin cache (PlayerState is already null at logout). Live proof pending.

chat-message.reason: ConanPlayerController.ServerSendChatMessage through the hook dispatch: Steam64 from the called controller, text and channel from ChatRpcData (Global and Local -> global, Clan -> team). Live proof pending.

player-death.reason: EventOnDeath transition to Dead on a player-controlled character, killer from OnOwnerKilled, cause from the last damage; position from K2_GetActorLocation. Live proof pending.

entity-killed.reason: EventOnDeath transition to Dead on a non-player character whose last damage came from a ConanPlayerController; entity display name and weapon item name read inside the hook. Live proof pending.

log.verification: Live 2026-10-03 on rig 349 (bridge stopped): Takaro log hook l2c-log-serverstats executed on three consecutive real LogServerStats lines 0.7-0.9 s after they were written (MCP eventSearch hook-executed; El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2c)
log.reason: Worker-thread tail of ConanSandbox.log (follows the rotation at server start), redacted and rate limited (30 lines/s, burst 300, a summary line for dropped lines), plus the connector's own critical notices.
